about_short_description.short_description: Rentify is a fintech and proptech startup.

product.name: Rentify Pay
product.description: A digital rent payment platform for tenants, landlords, and property managers that supports monthly installments, card and Apple Pay payments, payment tracking, receipts, and rental workflows.

product.name: Rent Now, Pay Later (RNPL)
product.description: A rent financing service that pays a landlord the annual rent upfront while allowing an eligible tenant to repay the amount through scheduled installments, typically monthly.

product.name: Earn AI
product.description: An AI-enabled rental revenue management platform for UAE landlords and property managers that automates rent collection, payment reminders, renewals, bounced-cheque follow-up, and portfolio performance analysis.

product.name: BELONG Rewards
product.description: A rental payment rewards program that awards points or BELONG coins for successful rent payments and allows users to redeem them with participating shopping, dining, travel, wellness, and service brands.

identifier.value: Digital Rental Agreements and Tenancy Management

product.name: Digital Rental Agreements and Tenancy Management
product.description: Digital tools for creating, renewing, storing, and managing rental agreements, with Ejari-compatible documentation, tenant verification, payment records, reminders, and support for the rental lifecycle.
